title: The Play store text says members can export their workouts to Excel, but the app saves a plain list file meant for re-importing
what: The store description that the listing run publishes says 'Export your workouts to Excel'. The app's only workout export is 'Save my history', which writes a comma-separated text file in Hevy's own column layout, one row per set, made to be read back by the app's importer. The older Excel exports were removed. The file does open in Excel, but it is not an Excel workbook and its columns are not laid out for reading.
expected: The store words match what the app makes, for example 'Save your whole history as a file you can open in Excel or bring back later', or the app offers a real Excel export.
how_often: every visitor to the store page
fix_line: Change the store line to say what the file really is, then re-run the listing update

items.reason: Words that leave this area for real people: Play What's new (taken from the tag's own whatsNew.ts, cut to 500 characters, fallback 'Small fixes and improvements.'), the Play store title and description (listing-draft.txt), and the GitHub release (title 'MettleUp vX', auto commit notes; members never see that page: the update button opens the APK file itself). The two WhatsApp test texts go only to the owner's own phone ('tell Claude' is an inside word but owner-only). Everything is English (Play notes en-US); the apps offer no Hinglish setting, so the Hinglish and Hindi read-aloud parts do not apply. No banned-word list was given, so none was checked.

Followed What's new from the tag to Play (phone and watch get the same notes; production is refused in code) and spot-checked the store listing's promise lines with one search each: Excel export and Google Drive backup are wider than the app. Paid extras (watch, weight suggestions, calculators) are open to all today because the member plan switch is off (packages/theme/src/memberPlan.ts:28); the listing does not mention Plus and will be wider than reality the day that switch goes on.
Register: P-A7-store-1-02 ('free, no ads') is already 'partly'; the Excel line is not in the register yet. The outage alarm's 'every 10 minutes' words were already found wider than reality.

No legal or privacy page lives here. Ways into live data from these runs: the WhatsApp token, the Cloudflare token that writes Worker secrets, Play and App Store keys, all under one code-store account (already found). No run holds a live database login or service key; the database tests use a fresh local database.
The only taps these runs create: the app's update link (lands on this release's APK file, not a general page) and the owner's outage issue. No app notification is posted from here.
No tap lands on a general page instead of the thing it names.
No screen or button here; the hand-start forms are GitHub's own.
No screen here; the store text is drawn by Play, and Play's length limits are checked in code (scripts/ci/play_listing.py:33).
The listing run uploads the icon (512x512, MettleUp M, current brand), the feature graphic (1024x500, MettleUp wordmark) and 8 screenshots of 1080x1920: the sizes Play asks for.
No old-brand or wrong-size picture found.

These runs post no app notification to members: only an outage issue and email to the owner and WhatsApp test messages to the owner's own phone.
